purpose: Five newly generated head-only pixel-art avatars
generation: Five independent new built-in ImageGen requests using the original identity references; not crops from previous full-body outputs
preparation: Whole-image proportional nearest-neighbour resize to a transparent 512x512 canvas only. No cropping or character redrawing.

characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final HEAD-ONLY pixel-art game avatar for 幸存兔, one avatar per image.
Primary request: Create a completely new pixel-art HEAD portrait of the ONE specified mascot from the original reference. This is a new head-only illustration, not a crop or a copy of a full-body character.
Framing: SQUARE canvas, a single isolated complete HEAD ONLY, front-facing at eye level, centered. The whole hairstyle/ears/hood must be inside the canvas with a small even transparent margin. Head fills roughly 85–90% of the square. There is NO neck, NO shoulders, NO torso, NO body, NO arms, NO hands, NO paws and NO feet anywhere. Finish the chin as a complete closed head silhouette.
Style: refined, lovable, polished game pixel art at roughly a 96x96 logical-pixel scale; intentionally designed clean square pixel clusters, stepped contours, warm deep-brown outlines, coherent limited palette, soft 2–3 tone pixel shading, crisp highlights and expressive eyes. Same front view and soft upper-left illumination across the five-mascot set. Preserve the reference's identity, colors, ear/hairstyle proportions and facial expression.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA, no white/black background, no checkerboard, no ground shadow, no scene.
Constraints: ONE head only. No montage, sprite sheet, duplicates, body parts below the chin, text, watermarks, UI, extra props, accessories or clothing. Do not reproduce the reference panels or reference layout.
Subject identity: Original image 1 is a five-character identity reference. Use ONLY the FIRST character from the left, 课代饼: human mascot head, short rounded dark-brown hair and the same bangs, large unmistakable red oval eyeglasses, warm peach face, large brown eyes, tiny cheek mole. Human ears, no animal ears. Render only his complete head, ending cleanly at the rounded chin; neck and body must not exist.
